text: {"findings":[{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Driver-level randomization leaks across arms in dispatch test","detail":"Dispatch is a routing/assignment change that shares one supply pool, so randomizing by driver leaks effects between arms. The standard requires switchback, geo, or market-level designs.","evidence_quote":"A/B test randomized by driver.","citations":["experimentation-standards#marketplace-interference"],"recommendation":"Use a switchback, zone-level, or geo/market design instead of driver-level randomization."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Test duration under 14 days","detail":"The plan runs for 5 days, below the 14-day minimum needed to cover two weekly cycles. No Data Science sign-off for a shorter test is recorded.","evidence_quote":"Run for 5 days.","citations":["experimentation-standards#duration-and-seasonality"],"recommendation":"Run at least 14 days, or obtain and record Data Science sign-off for a shorter test."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"No MDE, power, sample size or stopping rule pre-registered","detail":"The plan does not record an MDE, sample size or power, or a stopping rule before launch, as pre-registration requires.","evidence_quote":"Compare on-time rate between arms.","citations":["experimentation-standards#pre-registration"],"recommendation":"Pre-register the primary metric, MDE, sample size/power, and stopping rule before launch."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Problem claim has no quantification and weak sourcing","detail":"The problem is supported only by a vague reference to an audit report with no figures, and the baseline of 87% has no source.
